why_deferred: O1 uses one Owner self-check and does not require an independent spec reviewer.
escalation_trigger: Any missing timestamp-derived reader, failed-success marker ordering, lease bypass, or mismatch between requested diary-only filtering and broader scheduler stages blocks implementation.

verified_facts: sessions.start_time is stored as UTC Z timestamps and multiple Core readers currently derive dates with substr(start_time,1,10)
manual diary regenerate and scheduler diary generation call regenerateProjectDiaryEntryWithAgent
buildDiary renders a deterministic session-count fallback when sessions exist without a persisted project_daily_diaries row
the scheduler final transaction is the durable success-state boundary and confirmed diary writes remain transactionally protected
token_usage is derived from sessions and can remain compatibility storage while date-scoped readers use timestamped sessions

resolved_findings.finding: The first draft broadened target-date eligibility to Project summary and Kanban although the accepted user decision covered Daily diary generation only.
resolved_findings.resolution: Proposal, Design, Delta and test case now limit the new eligibility filter to scheduled Daily diary generation and preserve existing Project summary/Kanban scope.
